packageRules.description: Bundle every non-plugin library bump (libs.versions.toml + dependencies blocks) into a single PR. Plugins are excluded because matchDepTypes restricts to 'dependencies' (Renovate uses 'plugin' for build.gradle plugins {} entries).

Override: Kotlin plugin + Kotlin stdlib/reflect + KSP must move in lockstep (compiler ABI). Runs after gradle-libraries so org.jetbrains.kotlin libraries get pulled out of the libraries bundle back into this group, paired with the plugin and KSP.
Group all GitHub Action updates (digest pinning handled by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests preset above)
